descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-04 steps 1-5 and Expected · “The unassigned box stays on the sheet after reopening, as the physician's own log”.

Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S01 Full UAT walk: three boxes, two assigned, one left as a log, close/reopen, re-assign, Nursing Home

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U3 A box that starts with a room number (e.g. 'bed 415…') shows a room chip, and the picker suggests that room's patient. The physician still taps to assign; nothing auto-assigns. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 4; TFA-92582 step 4; TFA-92583 AC 3)
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)
  • U5 Re-assign works: re-assigning a box to a different patient adds its text to the new patient's encounter note and leaves it in the first patient's note. … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 6; TFA-92582 step 6)
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 2; TFA-92583 AC 2)
  • U8 Quick Dictation is Hospital only and is absent in Nursing Home. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 8)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician with three Hospital patients: QA Hosp Patel (room 415, encounter note 'Overnight cross-cover: no events.'), QA Hosp Ortiz (416), QA Hosp Lund (417)

When Open Quick Dictation from the Hospital list, type three boxes (the first starts 'Bed 415'), Link box 1 to the suggested patient, assign box 2 to Ortiz through the picker, leave box 3, close and reopen, re-assign box 2 to Lund, open the three charts, switch to Nursing Home

Then Room chip and suggestion on box 1 only, nothing assigned before a tap; box 1 at the end of Patel's note word for word; box 2 on Ortiz and on Lund; box 3 still on the pad, unassigned, on no chart; no Quick Dictation in Nursing Home

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. cp1: 'Rm 415' and '415 · QA Hosp Patel' shown, no 'Re-assign' (U3); exactly 3 'Assign to patient' and 3 'Delete compartment', so every box, the room-chip box included, has its own Assign and nothing was merged (U2, U6). cp2/cp3: both assigned labels and 'Re-assign' shown, box 3 text and an 'Assign to patient' button still there after reopening; …

Where it ran: dev unit U19; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
